build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template that creates two catapults with balls to touch each other
create_catapult_structure: create a catapult structure using static bars, a hinge ball, and a dynamic bar
define_task_parameters: define catapult position parameters using configurable X and Y coordinate lists
skip_invalid_params: skip template parameter combinations where catapults are placed too close together
set_task_meta: set the task metadata to require a two-ball solution with touching spatial relationship
